newsitem.title: USA: Mycogen acquires Argentina seed Co.
newsitem.headline: Mycogen acquires Argentina seed Co.

text.p: Mycogen Corp said Tuesday it has acquired Argentina's third largest seed company, Morgan seeds, for $27.4 million in cash, including debt repayment.
Morgan generates annual sales of roughly $25 million, Mycogen said.

"This acquisition immediately expands Mycogen's seed sales base and opens up significant growth opportunities in one of the world's most important markets for hybrid corn and sunflower seed," Jerry Caulder, Mycogen's chief executive said.
Mycogen will combine its Argentina unit, Agrigenetics SA with Morgan Seeds, and it has named its Argentine general manager, Ezequiel Fonseca, to head the combined company.
The new company will market seed products under the Morgan brand in several South American countries.
